apply_status_rejected: Application not approved. Please contact us for help
safety_instruction: Safety rules. Tap a picture to hear it
safety_no_burning_text: Never burn wires to get the copper. The smoke is poisonous and damages your lungs. Strip them with a wire-stripping tool.
safety_no_break_crt_text: Do not break the picture tube of an old TV. It contains lead and the glass can explode. Give the whole TV to the recycler.
safety_battery_fire_water_title: Keep batteries away from fire and water
safety_battery_fire_water_text: Keep batteries away from fire, strong sun and water. Do not press or puncture a swollen or broken battery, it can catch fire.
safety_gloves_pcb_text: Handle circuit boards and broken items only with gloves. Wash your hands with soap afterwards.
safety_no_acid_text: Do not use acid to take out gold or silver. It burns you and poisons the soil and water. Sell the boards to a recycler.
